page.overview:
Who is Miary Zo?

Please note: This name is Malagasy; “Nomenjanahary” is a family name, not a given name, and the supplemental name is Andrianavalona. The given name of this character is “Miary Zo”.

is a character in the Tekken fighting game series. She was revealed at EVO 2025 and appears in Tekken 8 as the final DLC character in Season 2.

Miary Zo is a fun-loving and friendly young woman, holding great respect for other fighters. She seeks to befriend those who challenge her in battle, and believes that even the loser in a battle stands to gain more than the winner. She is deeply connected to her culture and traditions, and is curious of nature and caring towards animals. Miary Zo is also shown to be very talented in martial arts, improving rapidly both from watching the movements of the animals around her and by facing many professional fighters.

Miary Zo is a Malagasy teenager with red eyes and brown hair. Her hair reaches the middle of her back and has cheek-length center-parted bangs, two small braids that come down in front of her ears, and a large braid which connects at the back of her head from each side that has yellow ribbon braided into it with a smaller yellow bow at the back where the braids meet. In the loop where these braids meet, there is a small design shaved into the base of her head. Her main outfit has colorful, nature-themed print on the fabric. When activating her abilities, teal symbols begin to glow on Miary Zo's skin, and her eyes also glow teal.
